### Classes

If you wish to go deeper into R, the following classes offered at the forestry faculty focus on R for different aspects (no guarantee that the list is complete):

#### Winter Semester

- M.FES.112: Biodiversity Measurement - R for ecology

- M.FES.114: Ecosystem-Atmosphere Processes - R for process-based modelling

- M.FES.115: Statistical Data Analysis with R - statistics (introduction)

#### Summer Semester

- M.FES.121: Advanced Data Analysis with R - statistics (advanced)

- M.FES.124: Modern Concepts and Methods in Macroecology and Biogeography - ecology (advanced), spatial data
